text:
elaine: Quick brainstorm — landing pages for Hosted / Dedicated / Private launch. Need hero lines (short), one-line benchmark hook for the blog, webinar gating flow, and inbound routing plan. 30m sync tomorrow?

mike: I can take hero hooks. For Hosted: `API-first text gen — instant, predictable latency` — is that too wordy?

sasha: @mike love that. Hosted should be time-to-value. Dedicated should lead with predictable throughput & SLA. Private should lead with security/compliance. Also one-sentence benchmark lede that links to the tests.

raj: Benchmark lede draft: "Same model — 3x lower median latency and ~25% lower per-token cost vs standard endpoints in our tests." We should surface a short gif of p99 vs p50. Link to test harness: /benchmarks/launch (placeholder).

nina: Design ask: can we do a 3-column hero comparison (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with tiny micro-CTAs: "Start Hosted", "Reserve Capacity", "Request Demo (gated)". Webinar CTA should appear in header for Dedicated + Private flows.

joel: Inbound routing: webinar registrants -> SDR queue tag=webinar-launch; Dedicated demo requests -> solutions-eng queue; Hosted trial signups -> automated onboarding email series. I'll sync with ops to set tags.

raj: Micro-copy options for Hosted hero (pick one per A/B):
- Option A: "Start inference in minutes — optimized for throughput"
- Option B: "Hosted API: fast, predictable LLM serving"

mike: For the benchmark narrative on social/blog: keep first para numbers-first. e.g., "Latency: 65ms median, 120ms p95; Cost: $X per 100k tokens" + CTA "See full benchmarks & try". Include GIF of request/response.

elaine: Can we have a live draft by EOD Friday? I'm booking 30m tomorrow 10am. @nina can you mock the hero comps? @joel please confirm SDR routing before sync.

webinar-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot requested for May 12 11:00 PDT — awaiting calendar approval.

sasha: Form fields for webinar: company, email, role, infra (cloud/on-prem). Add a checkbox: "Interested in private deployment" so we can route leads.

nina: UI note: keep hero overlay form to 3 fields to reduce friction. Move the "private interest" checkbox to the follow-up flow after signup.

mike: I'll draft 3 versions of social launch copy tonight — performance-first, cost-first, and security-first hooks. Will post in the doc for feedback.

elaine: :thumbsup: thanks all. If no blockers we'll kick off landing copy sprint tomorrow. Pasting draft doc here: https://redwood.app/docs/launch-landing-draft
